tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang 'bring du bya ba bzhugs so/ /

na mo gu ru he badzwa ya/ kyai'i rdo rje lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa mdor bsdus 'jug pa bde zhing dbang 'bring du bya na/ skyabs 'gro yig brgya sngon du btang nas/ rang he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas kyai'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi skyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu rgyan pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems pa tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ o bha ga wa na ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badzwa sa pa ri wā ra ni ri te hūṃ kham̐ swāhā/ ni wi te hūṃ kham̐ swā hā/ sarba sam̐ she dha ni swā hā/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ ma hā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzwa puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ge gandhe/ nai wi dye*/ shapta a hūṃ/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags| |'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rang sogs/ /sdom bzung gnyis byaḥ oṃ swā bha wa shud dhaḥsarba dharma swā shud dho3 haṃ/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi lus phra rags rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi| rtsibs logs rdo rje'i ra ba/ lpags pa rdo rje'i gur/ ba spu mda' yi dra ba/ skra sen ye shes kyi me ri 'bar bar gyur pa'i bsrung 'khor yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i nang du/ rang gi rkang mthil rlung/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha gyur pa'i steng du/ lus kyi 'dom gru bzhi dkyil 'khor gyi gru bzhi/ snying kha'i 'byung bzhi rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa bzhi sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re kha'i rtsig pa lnga/ sna rin chen pha gu/ so dra ba dra phyed/ lce mchu 'dod yon snam bu/ rna ba rta babs rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dur khrod brgyad du gyur pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad nyi'i lto bar rang nyid dpal kyai'i rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/

yum bdag med ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar thod skam gyis phreng bas brgyan zhing/ yab phyag rgya drug dang thod rlon gyi do shal/ yum phyag rgya lnga dang mgo phreng skom pos brgyan pa/ skyil dkrung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma| snying khar thugs rdo rje ma/ mig sogs drug gi sgor gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos kyi rdo rje ma/ lag pa g.yas g.yon/ kha gsang gnas/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon| pus mo g.yas g.yon/ spyi btsug rkang mthil rnams su rim pa bzhin/ gshin rje gshed/ shes rab mthar byed/ pad ma mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed| mi g.yo ba/ 'dod rgyal/ dbyug sngon can/ stobs po che/ gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ gnod 'dzes rnams so/ rang gi lus 'ja' tshon ltar gsal ba'i nang du rtsa ro rkyang gi dbus su chud pa'i dbu ma las gyes pa'i snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus kyi hūṃ yig sngon po yongs su gyur pa las mi skyod pa kyai'i rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum chu rnam par dag pa mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug bcu rtsa bzhi'i dbus kyi a yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ rin 'byung kyai'i rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnam par dag pa rin chen sgrol ma sku mdog ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ yum 'dra ba'i lha mo re bzhis bskor ba/

de bzhin du sbyar nas/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo bcu drug pa'i dbus kyi āḥyig dmar po las snang mtha' kyai'i rdo rje dmar po pad ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mos 'khyud pa lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo so gnyis pa'i dbus kyi haṃ yig dkar po las rnam snang kyai'i rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum chos dbyings rnam par dag pa dkar mos 'khyud pa lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba/ gsang gnas bde ba'i 'khor lo so gnyis pa'i dbus kyi hā yig ljang khu las don grub kyai'i rdo rje ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rlung rnam par dag pa dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khus 'khyud pa lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba/ de thams cad kyang rnam pa lha sku/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug ye shes kyi sku/ 'ja' mtshon lta bur gsal bar gyur pa rnams kyi dpral ba oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai'i rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ bo hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga'i gtso bo rgyal ba rdau rje 'chang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor yang rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mdun du dbang rdzas rnams tshang zhing mtshan nyid rdzogs pa dang bcas par gyur pa la dad gus tshad med pa la mchod/ maṇḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ spro na 'dir yang sdom bzung byas/ bla ma'i lus dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/ na ma te hūṃ/ na ma mi hūṃ/ na mo na ma hūṃ/ pra tī tstsha badzwa he pra ti grihna st+waṃ i maṃ sa twa ma ha ba la/

bla ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon gsum du mthong bar gyur/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dbang bskur mkhan gyi gtso bo bla ma'i lus dkyil gyi rigs lngas mdzad/ dbang bskur bya'i gtso bo rang gi lus dkyil kyi rigs lnga la byas pas mos nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yid/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ zhes gsung zhing/ chu dbang bskur/ de bzhin du bdud rtsi'i gnas su/ rin chen dang/ rdo rje dang/ dril bu'i dang/ ming gi bzhugayang na rim pa bzhin/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad ma/ las kyi/ 'khor lo dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ badzwa bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ badzwa gnas su/ ratna/ pad ma/ karma| tsakra bzhug thog mtha' med pa'i sogs/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi| zhe saugs dang yid kyi lus ni sogs kyi mthar/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ zung zhig rdo rje byin gyis brlabs/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar bgyis/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ phyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus po'i dri ma sbyangs/ dam tshig nyer gnyis bsrung ba la dbang ba dang/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang/ lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs/ grub mtha' ngo bo nyid gsum mngon du gyur/ 'da' ka ma gong du 'pho ba 'byongs/ 'bras bu sprul ba'i sku'i nus pa bzhag yang maṇd+ral phul/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyi rjes su/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyi gsol ba gdab/ bla ma yab yum gyi gsang rdzas 'theb srin gyis phyung| 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur| byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ / oṃ de wa pi tsu badzwa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ gsang rdzas myangs pa'i bde stong ye shes skyes par gyur/

bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob/ yi ge bha ga'i 'khor lo sbyangs| bza' bya'i dam tshig bsrung ba dang*/ lam bdag byin brlabs bsgom pa la dbang/ lta ba rang byung gi ye shes rtogs/ grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa mngon du gyur/ 'da' ka ma 'od gsal 'byongs/ 'bras bu longs sku'i nus pa bzhag go yang manṭal phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor cig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung/ /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag kyang de ltar mdzod| |'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs| |lha mo dga' ster gnas ster ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma| khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ khyod la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /zhes gsung nas rig ma gnang ba la snyoms 'jug tshul bzhin du byas pas lhan skyes kyi bde stong skyes so/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gsum pa thob/ khams bdud rtsi'i 'khor lo/ 'dzag med phyag rgya'i dam tshig bsrung| |lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo/ lta ba lhan skyes kyi yon tan grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ba/ 'da' ka ma rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'bras bu chos sku 'od/ yang manṭal phul/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi la yang/ /bka' drin gyis ni skyabs su gsol| |ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ zhes gsung nas thob bya zung 'jug la ngo sprad pa dge ba skyes par gyur/ don dam byang chub sems dpa' kyi dkyil 'khor/ dbang bzhi pa snying po ye shes rlung gi 'khor lo/ drang nges kyi dam tshig lam rdo rje rba brlabs/ lta ba rang bzhin rnam pa dag pa'i ye shes/ grub mtha' bde stong rgya che ba/

'da' ka ma phyag rgya chen po/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'o/ yang manṭal phul nas mchod bstod bya ste/ dbang lha thams cad rang la stim| bsngo ba dang bkra shis bya'o/ /lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang 'bring du bya ba| theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa skad gnyis smra ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shu bhaṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba'i shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang 'bring du bya ba/ -PAGE 132- -PAGE 133- -PAGE 127-
